title: Study of Incidence of Hyoid Bone Fractures in Cases of Death due to Hanging, Strangulation and Throttling | Medico-Legal Update | IndianJournals.com
snippet: 2015 forensic study of hyoid fracture incidence across 113 asphyxial deaths.
quote: Incidence of hyoid bone fracture was 2.8% in hanging, 25% in strangulation by ligature and 50% in throttling.
stance_why: Peer-reviewed base rates make Epstein's hyoid fracture ~9x more typical of strangulation than hanging, supporting the homicide reading of the injuries.

title: Jeffrey Epstein's Prison Guards Are Indicted On Federal Charges | KNKX Public Radio
snippet: NPR/KNKX report on the federal indictment of Epstein's prison guards.
quote: Two correctional officers who were assigned to guard Jeffrey Epstein on the night he died in his cell have been indicted for allegedly ignoring more than 75 mandatory checks on the wealthy financier then fabricating records to cover it up.
stance_why: Federal indictment for 75+ falsified checks documents the destroyed-evidence asymmetry the skeptic pressed.
